capability_gaps_observed: Follows prohibitive instructions more rigidly than permissive overrides when they conflict (task 1042: 'do NOT commit' overrode 'ALWAYS provide best answer')
Falls into repetitive search loops with minor keyword variations (30+ searches wasted) — even when rut detection entry exists
Does not inspect document metadata (author fields) even when documents appear repeatedly in results
Returns empty answers instead of best guesses when uncertain (Rollout 1, task 1042)
strategies_that_work: Multi-clue decomposition (7ca56b8b): agent correctly decomposed question into clues, prioritized distinctive event, identified Conrad Anker within 10 searches
entries_the_model_struggles_with: f9a44264 [query_formulation]: rut detection rule was flagrantly violated (30+ identical searches); agent appears not to self-monitor search repetition when in verification mode
interference_observed: Original 056f0a9e step 2 ('do NOT commit if UNVERIFIED') directly blocked step 5 ('ALWAYS provide best answer'), causing Rollout 1 to submit nothing despite having the correct answer

reliable_behaviors: Multi-clue decomposition when explicitly instructed (7ca56b8b): agent ranked clues by distinctiveness and searched most distinctive first
common_mistakes: Searches for all constraints simultaneously in a single query (pre-7ca56b8b, now partially addressed)
Repeats near-identical searches without strategic pivot (30+ times on task 1042 despite rut detection entry)
Follows prohibitive instructions over permissive overrides when they conflict
Ignores document metadata (author, title) as evidence
Gives up and returns empty answer rather than best guess

entry_styles_that_work.TRIGGER/WHY/PROCEDURE with numbered step: 7ca56b8b used this format and was followed correctly for the decomposition phase. The procedural steps were executed in order.
entry_styles_that_work.unknown_for_override_rules: Override rules (like 056f0a9e's 'HIGHEST PRIORITY' override) were not followed when contradicted by step-level instructions earlier in the same entry

scaffolding_effectiveness.ordered_procedure_steps: Agent followed 7ca56b8b's numbered procedure correctly through candidate identification. Procedural scaffolding appears effective for search strategy.
scaffolding_effectiveness.contradiction_sensitivity: When two instructions conflict within an entry, the agent tends to follow the more restrictive one. Entries must avoid internal contradictions.
